title: Federal corporate income tax rate reduced to 21 percent
summary: The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act reduced the federal C corporation rate from 35 percent to 21 percent.
affected_sector: Corporations subject to US federal corporate income tax
expected_mechanism: Lower statutory federal tax liability for taxable C corporation profits; actual effects depend on deductions, credits, and state taxes.

title: UK Corporation Tax main rate increased to 25 percent
summary: The main rate for non-ring-fence profits rose from 19 percent to 25 percent; a 19 percent small-profits rate and marginal relief apply under specified conditions.
affected_sector: Companies subject to UK Corporation Tax
expected_mechanism: Changes statutory liabilities according to profit thresholds, eligibility, and reliefs.
official_reference: Finance Act 2021 and HMRC Corporation Tax rates guidance

title: Irish implementation of the 15 percent Pillar Two minimum tax
summary: Ireland implemented a 15 percent minimum effective tax for multinational enterprise groups and large domestic groups within the legislation's scope.
affected_sector: In-scope multinational enterprise groups and large domestic groups
expected_mechanism: Top-up tax may apply where the effective tax rate under Pillar Two rules is below the minimum; this is not a general increase to the 12.5 percent trading rate.
official_reference: Finance (No. 2) Act 2023 and Irish Revenue Pillar Two guidance

title: 2019 Loudoun County Comprehensive Plan: data center land-use framework
summary: The countywide plan is a planning milestone for the siting and growth of data centers. Its provisions should be coded from the adopted text rather than inferred from later construction or tax receipts.
affected_sector: Data center development and related land uses
expected_mechanism: Planning designations and land-use policy may affect where facilities can be proposed or approved.

title: Loudoun County Data Center Standards and Locations zoning amendment
summary: ZOAM-2020-0001 revised county zoning standards and siting rules for data centers; verify the enacted text and applicability by parcel.
expected_mechanism: Siting and development standards may affect facility approvals construction timing and related local investment.
official_reference: ZOAM-2020-0001, Data Center Standards and Locations

title: Virginia conditional sales-and-use tax exemption for data centers
summary: Virginia Code § 58.1-609.3(18) provides a conditional exemption from July 1 2010 through June 30 2035 for qualifying data-center equipment/software purchases. Eligibility generally requires a $150 million investment 50 new jobs paid at least 1.5 times the local prevailing wage and a VEDP memorandum of understanding; special locality rules can alter thresholds.
expected_mechanism: Lower sales-and-use tax on eligible equipment can reduce qualifying data-center investment costs subject to job wage investment and reporting requirements.
